EDET 205.description: An exploration of instructional technologies and pedagogical approaches to design inclusive, engaging, and innovative learning experiences with an emphasis on digital citizenship, accessibility, learning theories, computational thinking, and collaboration.
EDET 205.subject: EDET
EDET 205.title: Instructional Technologies and Pedagogy

EDET 215.description: A survey of design thinking and computer science education topics and skills. Students will (a) use design thinking to solve problems and develop products and (b) explore a variety of technologies and their applications in the workplace, with hobbies, and within PK-12 schools.
EDET 215.subject: EDET
EDET 215.title: Introduction to Design Thinking and Computer Science Education

EDET 456.description: Fundamentals of artificial intelligence (AI) and its impact on lifelong learning, including a non-technical exploration of the mindset, knowledge and skills needed to engage ethically and effectively with AI tools.
EDET 456.subject: EDET
EDET 456.title: Learning with Artificial Intelligence

EDET 603.description: Study of multimedia elements (e.g., graphics, animation, audio, and video) including the creation and editing of materials. Instructional applications, copyright issues, and technology limitations will be explored.
EDET 603.subject: EDET
EDET 603.title: Design and Development Tools I

EDET 650.description: Supervised field-based experiences in the design, development, evaluation, and implementation of technology-based instructional and training projects.
EDET 650.subject: EDET
EDET 650.title: Internship in Educational Technology

EDET 652.description: Application of instructional design criteria to computer and noncomputer interactions. Analyses include requisite cognitive processes, affective outcomes, and ethical standards. Design and formative testing of interactive exercises.
EDET 652.subject: EDET
EDET 652.title: Design and Evaluation of Games and Simulations

EDET 700.description: An introduction to the field of learning design and technologies with a focus on the evolving scope, history, influences, and landscape of the profession.
EDET 700.subject: EDET
EDET 700.title: Foundations of Learning Design and Technologies

EDET 703.description: Critical analysis of research in multimedia programs and implications for instruction. Application of instructional design criteria to develop, author, and evaluate multimedia projects.
EDET 703.subject: EDET
EDET 703.title: Design and Development Tools II

EDET 705.description: An introduction to the relationships between biology, learning theory, and instructional models.
EDET 705.subject: EDET
EDET 705.title: The Learning Experience

EDET 709.description: Behavioral and cognitive learning principles applicable to the design of technology-based instruction and performance training.
EDET 709.subject: EDET
EDET 709.title: Applications of Learning Principles

EDET 722.description: Principles and models of instructional design and the assessment of learning. Applications of the instructional design process and assessment criteria to develop instruction and assessment tools for technology-based environments.
EDET 722.subject: EDET
EDET 722.title: Instructional Design and Assessment

EDET 735.description: Application of Universal Design, assistive devices, and other technologies to assure access to information and productivity tools by persons with disabilities, English-language learners, students at risk, and the elderly.
EDET 735.subject: EDET
EDET 735.title: Technological Applications for Diverse Populations

EDET 746.description: The organization and administration of media programs in school buildings and districts, regional and state centers, and colleges and universities. Procedures, problems, and trends for an integrated instructional support system will be emphasized.
EDET 746.subject: EDET
EDET 746.title: Management of Technology Resources

EDET 755.description: Telecommunications tools to support research and instruction across the curriculum. Study of distance education and issues related to instructional delivery, connectivity, and distribution methods.
EDET 755.subject: EDET
EDET 755.title: Design and Evaluation of Information Access and Delivery

EDET 780.description: A study of contemporary trends, problem areas, and issues in educational technology through literature investigations, seminar discussions, and case studies.
EDET 780.subject: EDET
EDET 780.title: Research Seminar in Educational Technology

EDET 793.description: Incorporation of instructional design criteria, multimedia development skills, knowledge of instructional methods, learning theory, and evaluation to develop a comprehensive multimedia or Web-based instructional project.
EDET 793.subject: EDET
EDET 793.title: Advanced Instructional Design and Development

EDET 801.description: A comprehensive study of the educational technology field, and an analysis of a significant question or issue related to teaching and administration in K12 schools, higher education, and/or other social institutions through literature investigation.
EDET 801.subject: EDET
EDET 801.title: Doctoral Research in Educational Technology

EDET 810.description: Introduction to the design of applied educational technology research with theoretical alignment of contemporary paradigms of research, purposes, research questions, ethics, and positionality.
EDET 810.subject: EDET
EDET 810.title: Principles of Applied Educational Technology Research

EDET 811.description: Advanced applied quantitative and qualitative methods for educational technology research using data collection, analysis, interpretation, and systematic study of a significant research problem related to teaching and learning in technology-enhanced learning environments.
EDET 811.subject: EDET
EDET 811.title: Advanced Applied Educational Technology Research

EDET 825.description: Evaluation and review of relevant research literature in educational technology to synthesize theories, trends, and issues related to the field.
EDET 825.subject: EDET
EDET 825.title: Evaluation of Educational Technology Research

EDET 826.description: Emphasis is placed on synthesizing research into an original, coherent and structured review of related literature.
EDET 826.subject: EDET
EDET 826.title: Synthesizing Educational Technology Research

EDET 850.description: Selected topical problems for advanced graduate students interested in technology-enhanced teaching, learning, and performance environments.
EDET 850.subject: EDET
EDET 850.title: Special Topics in Educational Technology
